heading: Stabilise before root cause
text: Shift, drain or shed first; root cause can wait until users are served. Note the old values so the move can be undone.

heading: 7. Proxy error scenarios: 502, 503, 504
text: Read the proxy's log line for one failing request before restarting anything. A deploy just before it? Rung 4: roll back.

heading: Save a snapshot before you dig
text: Looking is free; a restart erases what you came to see.

heading: 5.2 Deploy broke production
text: Roll back first, debug later. Stop if the release changed the data format or schema: then it is rung 8.

heading: 10.1 A routine config change takes production down
text: Put the previous file back and reload. Fix forward only once the rollback is ruled out.

heading: 10.2 Ran the command on the wrong server
text: Stop typing. Read what the command changed before trying to undo it, and tell the lead now.

heading: 1.1 netplan apply locks you out
text: One host, console open, netplan try so it reverts by itself.

heading: 7.1 DNS changed, old answers won't go away
text: Change one record; it takes effect only as fast as the old TTL allows. Next time lower the TTL a full old TTL ahead.

heading: 7.4 Pi-hole or AdGuard: port 53 busy, clients bypass
text: Name the owner of port 53 first. Do not stop the host's resolver before it has another one.

heading: 7.2 Web UI dead after an IP, hostname or NIC change
text: At the console, compare the live interface names with the config before editing anything.

heading: 8.5 Rolling update stuck or no rollback
text: docker service rollback, then find out why the new task was unhealthy.

heading: daemon.json keys that matter on-prem
text: A daemon restart touches every container on the host. On a Swarm node dockerd refuses live-restore, so nothing softens it: take a window.

heading: 9. Phase 8 — Cutover with minimal downtime
text: Prepare the routes on the side; the window holds only the switch.

heading: Failover, fencing and Patroni
text: The lead decides. Check replication lag and the backup first; one member at a time.

heading: 10. Kubernetes: nodes, storage and control plane
text: Cordon and drain one node before you change it; check PodDisruptionBudgets first.
